"""Tests for the compliance report reducer (subject.reduce_compliance)."""

from subject import (
    ModelComplianceCheckResult,
    ModelComplianceReportReduceRequest,
    ModelComplianceReportState,
    NodeComplianceReportReducer,
    reduce_compliance,
)

RUN_ID = "run-1"
REPO_ROOT = "/repo"
STARTED_AT = "2025-01-01T00:00:00Z"


def _result(node_id, passed):
    return ModelComplianceCheckResult(node_id=node_id, passed=passed)


def _state(results):
    return ModelComplianceReportState(
        total=len(results),
        passed=sum(1 for r in results if r.passed),
        failed=sum(1 for r in results if not r.passed),
        results=list(results),
        run_id=RUN_ID,
        repo_root=REPO_ROOT,
        scan_started_at=STARTED_AT,
    )


def _summary(state):
    return (
        state.total,
        state.passed,
        state.failed,
        [(r.node_id, r.passed) for r in state.results],
    )


def test_first_passing_result_on_empty_state():
    check = _result("node-1", True)
    new_state, intents = reduce_compliance(_state([]), check)
    assert _summary(new_state) == (1, 1, 0, [("node-1", True)])
    assert new_state.results[0] is check
    assert intents == []


def test_first_failing_result_on_empty_state():
    check = _result("node-1", False)
    new_state, intents = reduce_compliance(_state([]), check)
    assert _summary(new_state) == (1, 0, 1, [("node-1", False)])
    assert intents == []


def test_new_result_appends_and_updates_counts():
    a = _result("node-1", True)
    b = _result("node-2", False)
    check = _result("node-3", True)
    new_state, intents = reduce_compliance(_state([a, b]), check)
    assert _summary(new_state) == (
        3,
        2,
        1,
        [("node-1", True), ("node-2", False), ("node-3", True)],
    )
    assert new_state.results[0] is a
    assert new_state.results[1] is b
    assert new_state.results[2] is check
    assert intents == []


def test_metadata_carried_over_on_append():
    check = _result("node-1", True)
    new_state, _ = reduce_compliance(_state([]), check)
    assert new_state.run_id == RUN_ID
    assert new_state.repo_root == REPO_ROOT
    assert new_state.scan_started_at == STARTED_AT


def test_duplicate_replaces_in_place_without_changing_total():
    a = _result("node-1", True)
    b = _result("node-2", False)
    c = _result("node-3", True)
    check = _result("node-2", True)
    new_state, intents = reduce_compliance(_state([a, b, c]), check)
    assert new_state.total == 3
    assert len(new_state.results) == 3
    assert new_state.results[1] is check
    assert new_state.results[0] is a
    assert new_state.results[2] is c
    assert _summary(new_state) == (
        3,
        3,
        0,
        [("node-1", True), ("node-2", True), ("node-3", True)],
    )
    assert intents == []


def test_replace_pass_with_fail_moves_count():
    check = _result("node-1", False)
    new_state, _ = reduce_compliance(_state([_result("node-1", True)]), check)
    assert _summary(new_state) == (1, 0, 1, [("node-1", False)])


def test_replace_fail_with_pass_moves_count():
    check = _result("node-1", True)
    new_state, _ = reduce_compliance(_state([_result("node-1", False)]), check)
    assert _summary(new_state) == (1, 1, 0, [("node-1", True)])


def test_replace_pass_with_pass_keeps_counts():
    b = _result("node-2", False)
    check = _result("node-1", True)
    new_state, _ = reduce_compliance(_state([_result("node-1", True), b]), check)
    assert _summary(new_state) == (2, 1, 1, [("node-1", True), ("node-2", False)])
    assert new_state.results[0] is check


def test_replace_fail_with_fail_keeps_counts():
    b = _result("node-2", True)
    check = _result("node-1", False)
    new_state, _ = reduce_compliance(_state([_result("node-1", False), b]), check)
    assert _summary(new_state) == (2, 1, 1, [("node-1", False), ("node-2", True)])
    assert new_state.results[0] is check


def test_metadata_carried_over_on_replace():
    check = _result("node-1", True)
    new_state, _ = reduce_compliance(_state([_result("node-1", False)]), check)
    assert new_state.run_id == RUN_ID
    assert new_state.repo_root == REPO_ROOT
    assert new_state.scan_started_at == STARTED_AT


def test_input_state_not_mutated_and_new_state_returned():
    a = _result("node-1", True)
    b = _result("node-2", False)
    state = _state([a, b])
    before = _summary(state)
    new_state, _ = reduce_compliance(state, _result("node-2", True))
    assert _summary(state) == before
    assert state.results[0] is a
    assert state.results[1] is b
    assert new_state is not state


def test_reducer_execute_delegates_to_reduce_compliance():
    state = _state([_result("node-1", True), _result("node-2", False)])
    check = _result("node-2", True)
    expected_state, expected_intents = reduce_compliance(state, check)
    actual_state, actual_intents = NodeComplianceReportReducer().execute(state, check)
    assert _summary(actual_state) == _summary(expected_state)
    assert actual_state.results[1] is check
    assert actual_intents == expected_intents == []


def test_reducer_handle_composes_request_and_response():
    state = _state([_result("node-1", False)])
    check = _result("node-1", True)
    response = NodeComplianceReportReducer().handle(
        ModelComplianceReportReduceRequest(state=state, check_result=check)
    )
    assert _summary(response.state) == (1, 1, 0, [("node-1", True)])
    assert response.state.results[0] is check
    assert response.intents == []
